name: xplane-remote
description: Mobile flight companion for X-Plane 12: telemetry, state-confirmed pause/resume and WebFMC, served privately over Tailscale.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,green "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
